# A bowl as an ordinary gift

Gave the new bowl to Lena without a lecture about the glaze. She put oranges in it. [[Pottery]]: the object can enter another person's life without carrying my entire account of making it. The notebook can hold that account; the gift does not need to become a request for feedback.
